notes: Evangelical non-denominational church on the east side at Pantano and Broadway; address 530 S. Pantano Rd., Tucson AZ 85710 confirmed from the site footer. Leadership re-checked 2026-09-10 against ccctucson.org/our-leadership: Eric Naus is now titled Lead Pastor and preaches most Sundays. Floyd Morgan and Chase Hildenbrand both preached in 2026 and Tim Sheaffer in 2024-2025, so all four are recorded as preaching pastors. Other staff pastors (Joel Harris, Erwin Klingenberg, Randy McCormick, Tim Arrington) appear in the archive's preacher filter but not in the recent rotation - check before adding. The earlier search-snippet names resolve as follows: Brett Inman is an elder (on sabbatical), not preaching staff; Randy Reynolds appears only in the historical archive; 'Pastor Floyd' is Floyd Morgan. The sermon archive is indexed by preacher (ccctucson.org/sermons/preacher/...) and many sermons carry a downloadable sermon-manuscript PDF, which is unusually strong evidence for this project. Video is on the church's own YouTube channel, @ChristCommunityChurchTucson; caption availability untested. Coordinates are still only approximate; run tools/geocode.py.
